account.welcome.subject: Welcome to BIND
collaboration.opened.subject: Your collaboration with {business} has started
collaboration.opened.body:
Hi {creator},

You have redeemed {item} at {business}. Now publish a {format} and send us the proof before {deadline}.

{requirements}
Open the app to submit your proof.
collaboration.reminder.subject: Your proof for {business} is due soon
collaboration.reminder.body:
Hi {creator},

Your proof for {item} at {business} is due on {deadline}. Stories disappear after 24 hours, so send it while your post is still online.
collaboration.resubmit.subject: One more step for {business}
collaboration.resubmit.body:
Hi {creator},

{business} could not accept your proof for {item}:

{reason}

You have until {deadline} to send a corrected one.
collaboration.unfulfilled.subject: Your collaboration with {business} was not honoured
collaboration.unfulfilled.body:
Hi {creator},

The deadline for {item} at {business} passed without an accepted proof. This affects your reliability score.
collaboration.requirements.geotag: Add the business location to your post.
